title: Pidgeon Flight Simulator 1998
description: A low-poly 1998 retro flight simulator where you control a city pigeon navigating gusty urban wind tunnels between skyscrapers, stealing French fries from outdoor café tables, and dodging clumsy pedestrians while listening to compressed MIDI elevator tracks.

title: Schrödinger's Light Switch
description: A wall-mounted light switch in quantum superposition. Flipping it toggles the room between illumination and total darkness in parallel dimensions, occasionally summoning raccoons, disco balls, or thunderstorms when uncertainty collapses.

title: Suspicious Desk Drawer Maze
description: Tilt a virtual messy office desk drawer to guide a rogue marble through tangles of paperclips, rubber bands, sticky notes, and half-eaten mints, featuring satisfying wooden sliding acoustics and marble collision physics.

title: Quantum Coffee Cup
description: A mesmerizing WebGL fluid shader of a steaming ceramic coffee mug where the liquid surface displays realtime procedural Mandelbrot fractals and swirling vortex convection currents. Drag to stir milk into starry galaxies while ambient coffee-shop murmur and espresso machine steam hiss play.

title: Infinite Office Slinky
description: Send a metallic rainbow slinky bouncing down an infinite procedural office staircase with rhythmic metallic clangs and spring oscillation physics that respond to your mouse flick velocity.

title: Overly Dramatic Alarm Clock
description: A bedside alarm clock that wakes you up with symphonic gong explosions, marching band snare rolls, and air raid sirens, requiring you to violently smash or drag its snooze button across the room before it detonates.

title: Generative Botanical Terrarium
description: A sealed glass jar containing procedural ferns, moss, and bioluminescent mushrooms that grow and branch organically over time, reacting to gentle mouse-tap condensation droplets and soothing ambient forest soundscapes.

title: Office Chair Racing Simulator
description: Navigate a squeaky wheeled office chair down a linoleum hallway obstacle course of stray backpacks, open file drawers, and wandering interns, managing caster drift and desk fan propulsion.

title: Infinite Cat Piano
description: A virtual piano where every key press plays pitch-shifted meows, purrs, and yowls synthesized via Web Audio formants, allowing you to compose majestic feline concertos on the fly.

title: Hypnotic Kinetic Pendulum Wave
description: A mesmerizing WebGL simulation of 32 uncoupled pendulums of slightly varying lengths swinging in unison to create gorgeous recurring traveling waves, Lissajous curves, and hypnotic geometric choreography.
